name: Filter and explore the expanded work gallery
description: Verify visitors can filter work and inspect a project.
steps: Select Packaging and confirm only packaging projects remain.
Select Branding and open Blinders Cut — Brand Identity.
Inspect its full image and description, then press Escape.
expected: The branding preview shows its PDF artwork; closing restores focus and All work restores all 25 projects.

name: Navigate the updated portrait and contact on mobile
description: Verify mobile visitors can reach the portfolio content and contact options.
steps: Confirm the smaller Phemxy Concepts logo appears at the top left.
Open Menu and choose Services, then navigate to About me.
Confirm the new purple-background portrait is shown with its full composition.
Read the introduction and follow the contact link.
Inspect the Pinterest, Facebook, Instagram, X, and TikTok icons; confirm each matches the exact social URL supplied by the owner, including the Pinterest and Facebook share links.
expected: The new portrait is visible, the text is more readable, navigation closes correctly, and the email and phone links remain available without horizontal overflow. All five social links use the owner-supplied profile URLs and open safely in a new tab.

name: Browse every view of a multi-image project
description: Verify the gallery remains usable with reduced motion and project viewing can be cancelled.
steps: Enable reduced motion and filter to Print & events.
Use Next to reach image 2, select thumbnail 3, then use ArrowLeft and Previous.
Close with Escape, reopen the project, and choose Discuss a similar project.
expected: The gallery cycles through the two wristband designs and cup mockup with the correct counter; Escape returns focus and the enquiry link reaches Contact without losing the scroll position.

name: Pause motion and keep layout usable
description: Verify moving elements can be paused and resumed without hiding content or blocking navigation.
steps: Confirm the hero content is centered and the two work images appear beneath its introduction.
Inspect the selected-work cards and open the Plantain Chips, Fufu Powder, and portrait images; confirm no image is broken and the full artwork fits its frame.
Scroll to the project area and click Pause motion.
Confirm the moving marquee and rotating service text stop; inspect the services and About content.
Click Play motion, then navigate back to Home.
expected: The motion resumes, all content remains readable and reachable, the header remains available, and the logo retains its proportions.
